selectionHint: Sankhani liwu, chiganizo, kapena ndime. Mukhozanso dinani-kumanja.
appHint: Zomasulira zamawonekedwe zimasonkhanitsidwa popanda intaneti. Zina zimamasuliridwa pamakina. Mayina a zinenero amatsatira chinenero cha pulogalamu yomwe mwasankha.
fallback: Bing ikalephera, yesani Google (imatumiza mawu ku Google)
dynamicHint: Zomwe zimawonekera zimayikidwa patsogolo. Lekani kutulutsa owonera.
languageReset: Chiyankhulo cham'mbuyo sichikupezeka pa injini iyi; kusankha chinenero kwasinthidwa.
message1: Khodi yachilankhulo ndiyolakwika. Gwiritsani ntchito id, en, ja, zh-CN, ndi zina zotero.
message3: Lembani kiyi ya API mu Zochunira.
message4: Lembani ID yachitsanzo cha operekera mu Zochunira.
message6: Wothandizira sabwezera zomasulira. Onani chitsanzo, chinenero, ndi chiwerengero.
message9: Chiwerengero cha zotsatira za Bing sichikufanana.
message12: Mawu opanda kanthu kapena zilembo zopitilira 12,000.
message34: Wopereka amasintha mawonekedwe a chikhomo. Chida choyambirira chasungidwa.
message38: Zolembera zikusowa pazotsatira. Chida choyambirira chasungidwa.
message44: Wopereka adalephera m'magulu atatu. Dinani kumasulira kuti muyesenso.
message46: Kuchuluka kwa zotsatira za batchi sikufanana.
message48: Ma block onse opezeka amamasuliridwa kwathunthu.
message49: Malire okumbukira zinthu afikira. Bwezerani tsamba musanapitirize.
message50: Tanthauzirani masamba ndi makina atsopano komanso chilankhulo
message52: Kugwiritsa ntchito makina atsopano ndi chinenero
message58: Kwezaninso chowonjezeracho ndikutsitsimutsanso tsambalo kuti mutsegule mtundu watsopano.
message61: Tsitsaninso tsambali pomwe zowonjezera zatsopano zasinthidwa.
